text: You run a busy agency. Your phone never stops buzzing, and every client wants an answer, right now.
A new lead comes in, and nobody answers. A lead that waits an hour is far less likely to reply. Three days later, they have hired someone else.
Appointments come and go, and nobody marks what happened. Was it a show, or a no-show? Nobody knows.
The no-shows never get a call back. They just sit in the calendar, and slip away.
Good deals sit untouched, until they quietly turn grey, and fall out of the pipeline.
Meanwhile, the same contact turns up again, and again, and again, clogging your CRM.
And every month, you build the reports by hand. You are not careless. You just cannot watch every account, all day.
Then your client walks in, and tells you something you did not know. And you find out when the client tells you.
SubSync fixes that.
It watches every client account, finds what is going wrong, and puts a dollar figure on it.
Then it tells you what to do first, inside your CRM, under your own name.
Every morning, where do you start? Today tells you. It lists the accounts to save first, and what is at risk: about seven hundred and fifty-one thousand dollars, in eighty-seven quiet deals.
Speed to lead shows who is waiting, and for how long. Thirteen new leads are past your target, so you call the longest wait first.

Appointments tells the truth. Four have no outcome marked, so your real show rate is fifty-seven percent, and eight no-shows are waiting to be won back. The flow tree shows which person, or calendar, loses your bookings.
The funnel shows where deals sit, and the biggest leak. Replay it day by day, and click any step to open those deals. Deals with no value still show up.
Find a lead searches every client account at once, with leads that never had a reply, leads going cold, and ready-made call lists.
Clean-up found one hundred and sixty-three duplicate groups, sorted by how sure it is. Nothing is deleted until you type a confirmation.
Clients puts every client account on one screen. Five need you now, and two paid plans are past due.
The account audit puts a monthly dollar figure on what your accounts are losing. The team page shows who is slow, and who earns the money.
Alerts reach you in Slack or email, with a link that opens the right account in your CRM. You know before your client does.
It wears your brand, not ours. It only changes things after a preview and a confirmation, and you can undo it. Install it once. Free for fourteen days.
